es_to_en.Bienvenidos a vuestra primera misión ofi: Welcome to your first official mission. I am Selene, of the Prontera elite: today you answer to me.
es_to_en.Desde hace semanas los pescadores de Alb: For weeks the fishermen of Alberta have seen lights in the sunken ship at night, and two of their boats have not come back to port.
es_to_en.Dicen que dentro del casco se oyen canto: They say songs and boarding orders can be heard inside the hull. Captain Drake's crew has lain at the bottom of the sea for centuries... and something is waking them up.
es_to_en.Vuestra tarea es entrar, averiguar qué p: Your task is to go in, find out what is going on and come back to report. No heroics: if you see something beyond you, get out.
es_to_en.¿Unos cuantos peces y esqueletos podrido: A few fish and rotten skeletons? This is a piece of cake.
es_to_en.¡Os espero dentro... si es que llegáis!: I'll wait for you inside... if you ever get there! I'm going ahead!
es_to_en.¡Haru, espera! ¡No vayas tú solo!: Haru, wait! Don't go in alone!
es_to_en.Siempre igual... Mi hermano tiene que se: Always the same... My brother has to be first at everything.
es_to_en.Id tras él antes de que se meta en un lí: Go after him before he gets into trouble. And bring him back in one piece.
es_to_en.Vamos. Lo encontraremos antes de que hag: Let's go. We'll find him before he does something stupid.
es_to_en.Qué oscuro está esto... ¿Haru? ¡Haru!: It's so dark in here... Haru? Haru!
es_to_en.Nada. Si lo conozco, habrá ido directo h: Nothing. Knowing him, he went straight to the deepest part of the ship. Let's look for the stairs to the hold.
es_to_en.Busca a Haru: encuentra la escalera a la: Look for Haru: find the stairs to the hold
es_to_en.Ahí está la escalera a la bodega. Si Har: There are the stairs to the hold. If Haru came this way, he must be down there already.
es_to_en....¿Notas eso? Hace muchísimo frío de re: ...Do you feel that? It's suddenly freezing cold.
es_to_en.¡¡Aaaaah!! ¡Socorro...! ¡Sacadme de aquí: Aaaaah!! Help...! Get me out of here!
es_to_en.¡Está todo oscuro...! ¡¿Alguien me oye?!: It's all dark...! Can anyone hear me?!
es_to_en.Busca a Lain: sus gritos venían del este: Look for Lain: her screams came from the east of the ship
es_to_en.Está unida a unos mecanismos. Tiene que: It's linked to some mechanisms. There must be three, on the walls of the other rooms on this deck.
es_to_en.¿Lain? ¡No...! ¡Es una trampa, salid de: Lain? No...! It's a trap, get out of here!
es_to_en.Jo, jo, jo... Este novato bocazas entró: Ho, ho, ho... This loudmouthed rookie walked into my cabin as if he owned it. He'll do nicely for my crew... and you'll be next.
es_to_en.Ahora sí... Entré a por todas y ese pira: Now I am... I charged right in and that pirate locked me up before I knew it.
es_to_en.Eres un cabezota. Vámonos de aquí antes: You're so stubborn. Let's get out of here before he comes back.
es_to_en.¡Por fin! Empezaba a pensar en entrar yo: At last! I was starting to think about going in myself. What happened in there?
es_to_en.Un fantasma, Ghostring, me atrapó junto: A ghost, Ghostring, caught me by the stairs to the hold. And below, Captain Drake had Haru locked up in his cabin.
es_to_en.Drake ha despertado, y su tripulación co: Drake has awakened, and his crew with him. But we gave him a good beating: he fled through a portal.
Haru. I told you no heroics. You went in alone, without waiting for anyone, and it nearly cost all of you dearly.
es_to_en.Un miembro de la élite no se adelanta pa: A member of the elite doesn't rush ahead to show off: they protect their own. You'll have time to think about it in Prontera... cleaning the Peco Peco stables.
es_to_en.Vosotros, en cambio, habéis hecho un tra: You, on the other hand, did an excellent job: you kept calm, rescued your companions and found out what was going on.
es_to_en.Pero esto no ha acabado: Drake ha huido,: But this isn't over: Drake has fled, and it won't be long before he gathers his crew again. We'll have to hunt him down in his lair, deep in the ship.
es_to_en.Informaré a Prontera. Cuando estéis prep: I'll report to Prontera. When you're ready, you'll go back for him. For now, here: you've earned this.
es_to_en.Gracias por todo. Sin ti no lo habríamos: Thank you for everything. We wouldn't have made it without you.
es_to_en.¡Ah! ¿Has oído eso? Un crujido... justo: Ah! Did you hear that? A creak... right above us.
es_to_en.Solo será la madera del casco... Este ba: It must just be the hull timbers... This ship gives me the creeps.
es_to_en.Cajas y redes podridas: aquí guardaban l: Crates and rotten nets: this is where they kept the supplies.
es_to_en.Haru, si estás escondido para darme un s: Haru, if you're hiding to scare me, it's not funny at all.
es_to_en.Mira, huellas en el polvo... Son de bota: Look, footprints in the dust... Boots, and recent. They must be Haru's.
es_to_en.Ha estado aquí, pero se ha ido. Siempre: He's been here, but he's gone. Always in such a hurry.
es_to_en.¡¿Qué ha sido ese golpe?! Ha sonado como: What was that bang?! It sounded like a door slamming shut...
es_to_en.No hay nadie. Sigamos, pero no te separe: There's nobody here. Let's keep going, but stay close to me.
Hammocks... this is where the crew slept.
es_to_en.Siglos bajo el agua y siguen colgadas co: Centuries under water and they're still hanging, as if someone were coming back to use them.
es_to_en.Un cofre abierto y vacío. Si ha sido Har: An open, empty chest. If Haru did this, he's in for it when we find him.
es_to_en.Esto era el comedor de los oficiales. Ha: This was the officers' mess. There are plates still laid out...
es_to_en....y la comida está fresca. ¿Quién ha es: ...and the food is fresh. Who has been eating here?
This corridor leads to the east of the ship. There's an icy draft coming from there...
es_to_en.Mejor no separarnos. Haru tiene que habe: Better not split up. Haru must have gone towards the stairs.
es_to_en.¿Has visto, Lain? ¡Invitados por el rey: See that, Lain? Invited by the king himself! After the ship business, we're famous.
es_to_en.Famosos por meterte tú solo en el camaro: Famous for walking into a pirate's cabin on your own... Behave today, it's a royal wedding.
es_to_en.Me alegro de verte. Selene dice que lo d: Good to see you. Selene says she told the king himself about the ship.
es_to_en.Tranquila. ¿Qué puede salir mal en una b: Relax. What could go wrong at a wedding?
es_to_en.Si el príncipe está muerto... entonces,: If the prince is dead... then who is that?
es_to_en.Haru, no te muevas. Ese aire helado... e: Haru, don't move. That icy air... it's like on the ship.
es_to_en.¡Lo sabía! ¡Ese príncipe olía a orco des: I knew it! That prince smelled of orc from the door!
es_to_en.¡Cuidado! ¡Va a por el rey!: Look out! He's going for the king!
es_to_en.¡Sigues en pie! Los demás... no se mueve: You're still standing! The others... they're not moving.
es_to_en.Esos orcos van a pagar por esto. Lain, t: Those orcs will pay for this. Lain, cover the left. Don't let them reach the king!
es_to_en.Ugh... ¿Qué fuerza tiene este bicho...?: Ugh... How strong is this thing...?
es_to_en.Tres crías y ni un adulto que las protej: Three whelps and no grown-up to protect them. Finish them!
es_to_en.¡Es la élite de Prontera! ¡Y Selene va c: It's the Prontera elite! And Selene is with them!
es_to_en.Habéis aguantado mucho más de lo que nad: You held out far longer than anyone expected. Stay behind us: it's our turn now.
You held out against a whole horde. That's no small thing.
es_to_en.Lo vimos todo, Majestad. Orc Hero se la: We saw everything, Your Majesty. Orc Hero took her... he said to the lands of the orcs.
We will, Your Majesty. You have my word.
es_to_en.No pienso quedarme de brazos cruzados. ¿: I'm not going to sit around doing nothing. You neither, right?
es_to_en.Dejad que los sanadores se ocupen del re: Let the healers take care of the king. Outside: we have a lot to plan.
es_to_en.El rey está a salvo con los sanadores de: The king is safe with the church healers. But the princess is still in Orc Hero's grasp.
es_to_en.Le hemos dado nuestra palabra a Su Majes: We gave His Majesty our word: we'll bring her back. And there's no time to lose.
es_to_en.Los orcos no salieron de la nada. Sus tr: The orcs didn't come out of nowhere. Their tribes hide in the fields of Geffen: that's where we'll start looking for her.
es_to_en.Salimos hacia Geffen al amanecer. Hay qu: We leave for Geffen at dawn. We have to investigate before they take her any further.
es_to_en.¡Nosotros también vamos! Esta vez no pie: We're coming too! This time I won't rush ahead... much.
es_to_en.Haru... Selene, contad con nosotros. Le: Haru... Selene, count us in. We owe this kingdom a lot.
es_to_en.Contaba con ello. Y contigo también: hoy: I was counting on it. And on you too: today you showed what you're capable of.
es_to_en.Ya llevas el uniforme de {job}. Te esper: You already wear the {job} uniform. We'll see you in Geffen.
es_to_en.Para lo que nos espera en Geffen no bast: What awaits us in Geffen calls for more than you know now. It's time to take the next step.
es_to_en.Y toma esto: la insignia de la patrulla: And take this: the Prontera patrol badge. In Geffen it will open every door.
es_to_en.¡Nos vemos al amanecer, camino de Geffen: See you at dawn, on the road to Geffen!
